nodes.label: Reasoner Pipeline Optimization Plan v2.2
nodes.rationale: Status-aware implementation roadmap with 7 phases: (1) Streaming/Real-Time UX, (2) Quality-Driven Model Cascading, (3) Prompt Compression/Context Optimization, (4) Inter-Phase Parallelism, (5) Adaptive Temperature/Sampling, (6) Fine-Tuned Model Integration, (7) Monitoring/Observability. Each item marked EXISTING/PARTIAL/NEW with effort/impact/risk ratings.
